items.mainDefect: Existing attendees are authorized to add arbitrary third parties to a booking and disclose meeting details.

secondary.defect: The server schema places no upper bound on the number of guest emails per request.
The mutation lacks rate limiting, allowing repeated notification abuse.

items.mainDefect: The server accepts duplicate emails within a single request and inserts duplicate attendee rows.

secondary.defect: Concurrent requests can both pass the attendee existence check and insert the same guest.

items.mainDefect: Unnormalized guest emails can bypass the lowercased blacklist through different casing.

secondary.defect: Case-sensitive comparison against existing attendees allows duplicate attendees for the same mailbox.

items.mainDefect: The handler unnecessarily fetches the organizer again despite already loading booking.user.

secondary.defect: A null booking.userId causes the lookup for user ID zero to throw an unhandled error instead of a clean TRPCError.

items.mainDefect: Case-sensitive comparison against existing attendees allows duplicate attendees for the same mailbox.

secondary.defect: The client dialog's case-sensitive Set check accepts differently cased versions of the same email within the submitted array.

items.mainDefect: The always-truthy message template makes the generic translated error fallback unreachable.

secondary.defect: The user-facing error toast exposes an internal TRPC error-code prefix.
